newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-CURRIE CUP RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CURRIE CUP RESULTS.

text.p: Results of the Currie Cup
rugby union matches played at the weekend:
In Pretoria: Northern Transvaal beat Boland 26-23 (halftime
Scorers:
Northern Transvaal - Try: Jannie Claassens. Penalties:
Roland de Marigny (6). Drop goal: de Marigny.
Boland: Tries: Stefan Terblanche (2). Conversions: Pieter
O'Neill (2). Penalties: O'Neill (3).
In Durban: Natal beat Border 76-6 (halftime 31-6).
Scorers:
Natal - Tries: Dieter Kriese (2), Kevin Putt, Andre Joubert,
Pieter Muller (2), Wayne Fyvie (2), Danie van der Walt, Joos
Joubert, Gavin Lawless, Walter Minnaar. Conversions: Luke Smith
Border - Penalties: Dale Heidtmann (2)
In Bloemfontein: Western Province beat Free State 31-22
(halftime 17-9)
Scorers:
Free State - Try: Brendan Venter. Conversion: Andre Fourie.
Penalties: Fourie (5).
Western Province - Tries: Justin Swart, Simon Berridge,
Bobby Skinstad, Louis Koen. Conversions: Koen (4). Penalty:
Koen.
In Potchefstroom: North West beat Mpumalanga 30-3 (halftime
Scorers:
North West - Tries: Hannes Human, Tony Lincoln, Henk
Schalekamp. Conversions: Jaco Coetzee, Bertus Kruger (2).
Penalties: Kruger (3).
Mpumalanga - Penalty: Andries Fourie.
In George: South Western Districts beat Northern Free State
64-31 (halftime 19-3)
Scorers:
South Western Districts - Tries: Barney Vorster (3), Braam
van Straaten, Thys Stoltz, Anton Leonard, Paul Treu (2), Johan
Kapp. Conversions: van Straaten (8). Penalty: van Straaten.
Northern Free State - Tries: Koos Heydenrich (2), Tommy de
Beer, Eugene Delport. Conversions: Eric Herbert (4). Penalty:
Herbert.
In Johannesburg: Gauteng Lions beat Griqualand West 46-39
(halftime 24-19).
Scorers:
Gauteng Lions - Tries: Joe Esterhuizen, Joggie Engelbrecht
(3), Jannie van der Walt. Conversions: Johan Roux (3).
Penalties: Roux (5).
Griqualand West - Tries: Tobie de Jager, Lourens Venter (2),
Kraai van Niekerk. Conversions: Franco Smith (2). Penalties:
Smith (5)
